summary: Roma Green Finance Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing a subscription agreement to invest up to US$10 million in BlueFlare Group Holdings Inc. for up to 5% equity (50 common shares at US$200,000 per share), with US$1 million paid upfront and the balance over ten months. This investment is under a new AI/HPC infrastructure vertical, marking Roma's first direct equity stake in a behind-the-meter compute platform. Board recommendation and advisors were not disclosed. Share allotment is pro-rated if full consideration is not paid. Watch for pro-rata share issuance and progress of payments.
